lore_anchors.definition: The name Zhuge Yuan gave Li Huowang to hide his identity; now belongs to the future Siming of Bewilderment, a version of Li Huowang that has become a celestial arbiter of fate.
A mortal who serves as a Siming's anchor to the world, acting as its 'past' and 'seed' to ensure its continued existence; a parasitic dependency where the god needs the mortal to exist.
The head of the Supervisory Heavenly Office; a figure who oversees celestial phenomena and advises the emperor on matters of fate, politics, and supernatural threats.

The underground energy channel that determines a dynasty's legitimacy and fate in Chinese geomancy; in the Dao-Twisted World, it also serves as a repository of institutional knowledge and political memory.
Bai Lingmiao's formal title within the White Lotus Society; her connection to Li Huowang is now a political concern for the Great Liang court.
